youtube.title: In This City, Every Lie Makes You Shorter
youtube.description: An original animated tiny satire: in this city, every lie makes you one inch shorter. Dave is six foot four and has never told a single lie – tonight he meets his girlfriend's mother. And she cooked. Pure fiction – the city, the rule and all characters are invented.

tiktok.caption: In this city, every lie makes you one inch shorter. Dave has to survive dinner with his girlfriend's mom. So… did you like this video? Careful. 📏 (fiction)
